Banana data

banana.Rd

A two-dimensional, two-class imbalanced data set. The positive (minority) class and the negative (majority) class both have a curved, banana-like shape and overlap with each other, so the data set contains the usual difficulties of imbalanced classification: a small minority class, class overlap, noise and small disjuncts. It is used in the examples and the vignette of the package.

Usage

banana

Format

A data frame with 2640 rows and 3 variables:

At1

first feature.

At2

second feature.

Class

factor with levels "negative" (2376 samples) and "positive" (264 samples). The imbalance ratio is 9.

Source

The banana data set of the KEEL data set repository, https://sci2s.ugr.es/keel/datasets.php.

References

Alcalá-Fdez, J., Fernández, A., Luengo, J., Derrac, J., García, S., Sánchez, L., & Herrera, F. (2011). KEEL data-mining software tool: data set repository, integration of algorithms and experimental analysis framework. Journal of Multiple-Valued Logic and Soft Computing, 17(2-3), 255-287.

Examples

table(banana$Class)
#> 
#> negative positive 
#>     2376      264 
plot(banana$At1, banana$At2, col = ifelse(banana$Class == "positive", "red", "grey60"),
     pch = 16, xlab = "At1", ylab = "At2")
